name: Secrets of Sal Atticum
source:
You've been told that things aboard the Star Ship Sal Stticum are pretty hectic, but this is ridiculous! Before you can focus on your secret mission, you have to help restore some kind of order.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

你听说星舰Sal Stticum上的事情非常忙碌，但这太荒谬了！在你专注于你的秘密任务之前，你必须帮助恢复某种秩序。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
